mergedParams.userDescription: Text appearing behind an object, revealed as the camera pans. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Typokinetic Text Reveal Behind Object with Camera Pan

prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic text reveal preset where text is initially hidden behind a foreground object/mask and gradually revealed through a smooth camera pan simulation. Think of this like a parallax effect in video editing where the text layer moves at a different speed than the masking layer, creating depth. The text should start completely obscured and progressively reveal as the 'camera' (actually CSS transforms) pans across the scene. Use a mask layer that slides horizontally while the text remains stationary or moves slower, creating the illusion of depth. The typography should have strong kinetic energy with each word having subtle entrance animations as they become visible - like a staggered fade-in with slight scale and blur transitions. Consider adding a subtle glow or shadow to make the text pop as it emerges from behind the object.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden w-full h-full' containing two main layers - a masking BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 z-20' for the foreground object (could be a ShapeAtom or ImageAtom with blend mode), and a text container BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center'. For the mask movement, use a generic effect with translateX from '0%' to '-100%' over the full duration with ease-in-out easing. The text should use TextAtom components with caption data for word-level timing. Apply staggered effects to each word: opacity 0→1, scale 0.8→1, blur 4px→0px as they're revealed. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' on the parent. Consider using an internal effect preset for the word reveal animation that can be reused. Performance: use transform and will-change properties, avoid animating width/height.

prompts.prompt: Design a typographic kinetics preset inspired by motion graphics where text appears to be painted or written behind glass, revealed by a wiping motion. Imagine a squeegee or wiper blade moving across the screen, revealing text that was always there but hidden by condensation or frost. The text should have a liquid, organic quality with individual letters having slight wobble animations. As the wiper passes, letters should spring to life with elastic bounce easing. Add environmental effects like subtle water droplets or frost particles that dissipate as the text is revealed. The overall effect should feel tactile and physical, as if the viewer is watching through a window being cleaned.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use a BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200' as the base. Create a wiper effect using a BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-4 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm' and animate translateX from '-100%' to 'calc(100vw + 100%)' with linear easing. For the text, use TextAtom components positioned with 'absolute' and specific top/left percentages. Apply a clip-path or mask that follows the wiper position. Each letter should have initial effects: opacity 0.3, blur 8px, scale 0.95, then transition to opacity 1, blur 0, scale 1 with spring easing as the wiper passes. Add particle effects using multiple small ShapeAtom components with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-blue-200/50' that fade and fall with gravity-like translateY animations. Use word-level caption timing for progressive reveal.

prompts.prompt: Build a documentary-style lower third preset where text emerges from behind a blurred foreground element that shifts out of focus. Think of rack focus in cinematography - the text starts hidden behind an out-of-focus object in the foreground, then as the 'focus' pulls to the background, the text becomes sharp while the foreground object blurs more. The typography should have a professional, clean animation with subtle tracking (letter-spacing) that tightens as the text comes into focus. Add a slight chromatic aberration effect during the focus transition for added realism. The kinetic typography should feel editorial and sophisticated.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full': foreground object as ImageAtom or ShapeAtom with 'absolute inset-0 z-20', initial blur filter of 0px transitioning to 20px. Text container as BaseLayout 'absolute bottom-20 left-10 z-10'. Use TextAtom with initial blur 15px transitioning to 0px, opacity 0.4→1, letterSpacing '0.2em'→'0.05em'. Add chromatic aberration using CSS filters or multiple text layers with slight color offsets (red/blue channels). Implement with generic effects using keyframe animations over 2-3 second duration with ease-out easing. Consider using sub-presets for the blur transition effect. For caption-based text, process word-level timing to create a subtle wave effect where each word sharpens slightly after the previous one.

prompts.prompt: Create an action-oriented preset where text bursts through a shattering barrier effect. Visualize text being behind a glass panel that cracks and explodes, revealing the kinetic typography with explosive energy. Each word or letter should feel like it's breaking through with force, accompanied by debris particles and shockwave effects. The text should have aggressive, punchy animations with overshoot on scale and rotation. Think of action movie title sequences where text crashes through walls or glass. Add camera shake to enhance the impact moment.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Create a glass layer using BaseLayout 'absolute inset-0 z-20 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md' that transitions to opacity 0. Generate shatter particles using repeatChildrenProps with 10-20 ShapeAtom components, each with 'absolute w-4 h-4 bg-white/20' and unique random transforms (rotate, translateX/Y) animating outward from center. Text using TextAtom with staggered effects per word: scale 0→1.2→1 (overshoot), rotate -5deg→0deg, opacity 0→1. Add screen shake using a wrapper BaseLayout with random translateX/Y values over 0.5s. Use waveform effects if audio is present to sync the shatter moment with bass hits. Implement debris with spring easing for realistic physics.

prompts.prompt: Develop a parallax scrolling preset where multiple layers of text move at different speeds to create depth, with the main text initially hidden behind foreground elements. Think of classic 2.5D animation where foreground, midground, and background layers move independently. The main kinetic text should slide in from behind silhouetted foreground shapes while background text layers create atmosphere. Each text layer should have different motion speeds and blur levels to enhance the depth illusion. Add subtle floating particles between layers for extra dimension.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use nested BaseLayout containers with 'relative w-full h-full' as root. Create 3-4 depth layers: foreground BaseLayout 'absolute inset-0 z-30' with ShapeAtom silhouettes translating at 100% speed, main text layer 'absolute inset-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-center' at 60% speed, background text layers at 30% and 15% speed with increasing blur (2px, 4px). Use generic effects with different translateX ranges for each layer. Main text uses TextAtom with caption data, applying word-by-word reveal with opacity and slight translateY. Add floating particles using repeatChildrenProps creating 20+ small ShapeAtom elements with 'absolute w-2 h-2 rounded-full opacity-50' and unique animation paths. Consider fitDurationTo: 'media' if syncing with video background.

prompts.prompt: Design a portal/doorway reveal preset where text appears to exist in another dimension, revealed as a portal or doorway slides open. Imagine a sci-fi door mechanism where two panels slide apart (or iris open) revealing glowing, energetic text floating in a void. The kinetic typography should have ethereal qualities - floating, pulsing, with energy waves rippling through the letters. As the portal opens wider, the text gains more energy and clarity. Add particle effects and light rays emanating from the portal edges for dramatic effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create portal doors using two BaseLayout panels 'absolute top-0 w-1/2 h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-gray-800', one with 'left-0' animating translateX from 0 to -100%, other with 'right-0' animating translateX from 0 to 100%. Portal glow effect using ShapeAtom 'absolute inset-0 z-10' with radial gradient and animated opacity/scale. Text container 'absolute inset-0 z-5 flex items-center justify-center' with TextAtom components. Apply pulsing glow effect using internal effect preset with textShadow animation. Each word gets staggered effects: scale 0.5→1, opacity 0→1, with slight float animation (translateY sine wave). Add light rays using rotated rectangular ShapeAtom elements with linear gradients and opacity animations.

prompts.prompt: Create a liquid mask reveal where text appears submerged underwater and is revealed as the water level drops or drains away. Think of text at the bottom of a swimming pool that becomes visible as the water drains. The typography should have caustic light effects and ripple distortions that gradually stabilize. As each word emerges from the water, it should have a splash or drip effect with droplet particles. The kinetic animation should feel fluid and organic, with text having subtle wave motions that dampen over time.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Water layer as BaseLayout 'absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-20 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-400/60 to-blue-600/80' with animated height from 100% to 0% using clip-path or height transition. Text using TextAtom with 'absolute' positioning for each word. Apply water distortion using CSS filters or transform skew animations that reduce over time. Initial state: blur 4px, opacity 0.7, translateY 10px. As water passes each word, transition to normal state with spring easing. Create droplet effects using ShapeAtom components spawned at word positions, animating with translateY (gravity) and opacity fade. Add caustic light overlay using animated linear gradients. Consider using waveform effects for ripple intensity if audio is present.

prompts.prompt: Develop a holographic interference preset where text is hidden behind visual noise/static that clears to reveal crisp kinetic typography. Imagine old TV static or holographic interference patterns that dissipate to show the text. The text should glitch and flicker into existence with digital artifacts, scan lines, and RGB channel splits. Each word should have a unique stabilization pattern, some flickering longer than others. Add data stream particles and matrix-like background elements for a high-tech feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-black'. Static overlay using BaseLayout 'absolute inset-0 z-20 mix-blend-screen' with animated opacity 1→0 and a noise texture background image. Create scan lines using repeatChildrenProps generating thin BaseLayout strips 'absolute w-full h-px bg-green-400/20' with varying translateY animations. Text with TextAtom, each word having randomized glitch effects: initial state with random translateX offset, RGB split using text-shadow with red/blue offsets, opacity flicker using rapid keyframes. Stabilize each word at different times using staggered animation delays. Add digital particles using ShapeAtom 'absolute w-1 h-4 bg-green-400/50' with vertical translateY movement. Use internal effect presets for reusable glitch animations.

prompts.prompt: Build a rotoscope-inspired preset where text appears painted behind live-action footage elements, revealed through animated masking. Think of hand-drawn animation where an artist has rotoscoped around a moving object to reveal text behind it. The mask should have an organic, hand-drawn quality with slight imperfections. The kinetic text should have a hand-lettered feel with slight jitter and bounce. As the mask animates, text springs to life with personality - letters might wiggle, scale, or rotate slightly as if hand-animated frame by frame.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full'. If video background exists, use VideoAtom as base layer. Mask layer using SVG path animation or clip-path with bezier curves, animating the path coordinates to create organic reveal. Text using TextAtom with custom positioning for artistic layout. Each letter gets micro-animations: slight rotation ±2deg, scale 0.98-1.02, translateX/Y ±2px on loop for hand-drawn feel. Initial mask hides text completely, then animated path reveals progressively. Add rough edge effect to mask using CSS filters (turbulence/displacement). Words should have staggered entrance with bounce easing. Consider using caption data to time reveals with speech rhythm. Add subtle paper texture overlay for artistic finish.

prompts.prompt: Design a dimensional fold preset where text exists on a different plane that's revealed as space itself folds or warps. Imagine a piece of paper folding to reveal text printed on the reverse side, or space-time bending to show hidden dimensions. The kinetic typography should feel like it exists in 3D space, with perspective transforms and lighting changes as the fold occurs. Each word should have its own depth and shadow, creating a layered typographic composition. Add particle effects that follow the fold line, suggesting energy or magical properties.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full' with perspective CSS property. Create fold effect using two BaseLayout panels 'absolute w-1/2 h-full', one with transform-origin 'right center' rotating rotateY from 0 to -180deg, revealing text underneath. Text container 'absolute inset-0 z-0' with TextAtom components positioned in 3D space using translateZ and rotateX/Y for depth. Each word has different z-index and perspective-based scaling. Apply lighting changes using filter brightness/contrast animations synchronized with fold angle. Add shadow layers using duplicate text with blur and offset. Fold line particles using ShapeAtom 'absolute w-1 h-1' spawned along the fold edge, animating with bezier curves. Use generic effects with custom easing curves for smooth 3D transitions. Consider sub-presets for the fold mechanism and particle system.
